sentences.text:
Shri Dinesh Singh Chouhan, learned counsel for the ap
 Shri Syed Asif Ali Warsi, learned counsel for the res
 Order

The present appeal has been filed by the State being aggrieved by the order dated 13.02.2021 passed by District Court in Reference Proceeding No.EXLA 15/2019 filed under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 whereby the original award passed by the land acquisition officer dated 23.05.2009 was modified and the amount of compensation was enhanced according to the valuation of the land acquired based on the guidelines issued by the Collector for the concerned year of 2007-2008.
2.

At the out set, learned counsel for the respondent submits that the present case is squarely covered by the order passed by this Court on 20.01.2026 in a bunch of appeals lead matter being F.A. No.1369/2022 (The State of Madhya Pradesh and others Vs. Kalu S/o Bagdiram (Deceased)
through LRs. Dhapurbai W/o Kaluji (Deceased) through LRs. Ramubai).
3. Learned government advocate though tried to argue the appeal on NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-IND:8590 2 FA-152-2022 merits, however, he is not able to dispute the fact that the order cited by the learned counsel for the respondent is with respect to same project, same notification for acquisition of land and same process of acquisition.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the appellant as well as the respondent.
5.

sentences.text: On perusal of the impugned order as well as the record of the case, the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respondent is found correct.
The present appeal is squarely covered by the order dated 21.01.2026 passed in the bunch of appeal lead matter being F.A. No.1369/2022.
